sentences.en: The Aponogeton species are self-fertile, responding to pollen from the same or different plants.

sentences.en: Actinidia deliciosa 'Solo' - Kiwi Fruit Actinidia deliciosa 'Solo' is a self-fertile kiwifruit, meaning that only one plant is needed to produce fruit.
